children: 1606 Corp. executed a non-binding LOI with EthosEnergy to pursue O&M for the ~55 MW Lufkin power facility following a potential acquisition.
LOI signed with EthosEnergy O&M to exclusively negotiate a definitive O&M agreement if 1606 completes the Lufkin acquisition.
The facility is an ~55 MW biomass plant on a ~132-acre East Texas campus that may require substantial recommissioning.
EthosEnergy brings extensive fleet O&M experience; engagement aims to support mobilization, operations, maintenance and performance.
LOI is generally non-binding; completion of any OMA depends on successful acquisition and further negotiation.
Acquisition remains subject to financing, title issues, pending litigation, and a closing deadline currently no later than Oct 31, 2026.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: 1606 Corp. and EthosEnergy execute LOI for operations of 55 MW Lufkin power facility
